title: Choose the Android review world
question: Keep the batch-release traveler, take an alternate, re-roll, or use the familiar Material 3 standard.

options.label: Batch Release Traveler
options.lineage: pharmaceutical batch-release travelers and QA sign-off sheets
options.thesis: Every commercial edit reads like a controlled release: evidence, calculation, and sign-off.
options.viewport: One Posting Line fills the phone: identity and evidence above a ruled commercial matrix, live net calculation, then a fixed review action.
options.risk: It becomes bureaucratic if stamps and labels compete with the editable numbers.

options.label: Dense Utility Mosaic
options.thesis: Invoice lines become a tightly ruled mosaic with exceptional scan speed and almost no wasted space.
options.viewport: A persistent invoice rail frames a dense grid of editable price and discount modules with totals visible at once.
options.risk: Tiny hierarchy can damage touch accuracy and Arabic legibility if density is pushed past the native floor.
options.case: Wins on product clarity, but identifies less directly with a pharmacy operator than the assigned traveler.

options.label: Deployable Fold Ledger
options.thesis: Each line opens from a compact identity strip into linked commercial cells whose changes propagate visibly.
options.viewport: The current line is deployed as a diagonal field while neighboring lines remain compact packets above and below.
options.risk: The fold grammar can obscure ordinary form affordances and become tiring across long invoices.
options.case: Fuses cleanly with split lines, but loses some immediate clarity when the operator only needs four numeric edits.

options.label: Sequential Step Instrument
options.thesis: Purchase price, Discount 1, Discount 2, and selling price form one unbroken sequence with a visible calculation chase.
options.viewport: A four-step commercial row dominates the phone while a sober readout shows the resulting purchase subtotal and new-stock price scope.
options.risk: Instrument language can feel gamified in a consequential financial workflow.
options.case: Clarifies sequence, but fuses poorly with the product because playfulness weakens financial seriousness.

canonCard.label: Material 3 Invoice Review
canonCard.thesis: A conventional list-detail review flow, executed with excellent native hierarchy and accessibility.
canonCard.viewport: A standard top app bar, item summary card, four editable fields, calculation summary, and bottom confirmation action.
canonCard.risk: It is immediately familiar but gives Pharma Auto little distinctive operational identity.
